summary: Ran a fresh isolated headless Google Chrome session on https://autopilot.local/ with no order, payment, form, email or cart side effects. The page raised no runtime errors and the knowledge section starts in the source state [open, closed], but page-owned crop selection, product slider/quantity controls and accordion state behavior are incomplete.
issues: HOME-INT-01 critical crop selector: all 23 rendered crop items are plain links, none exposes aria-pressed, and a prevented navigation click produces no active class or product-type popover. Implement the source active/selectable state (including the Fungicyd/Herbicyd/Insektycyd/Regulator/Nawóz panel) without replacing native destination links where they are needed.

HOME-INT-02 critical product carousel: all three product sections expose zero carousel buttons/pagination controls and are static grids, so the source previous/next/progress interactions cannot be used. Add accessible carousel navigation and retain keyboard/focus behavior.

HOME-INT-03 high quantity controls: 12 product-card quantity displays exist, but they contain zero buttons or inputs; minus and plus are decorative spans and quantity cannot change. Replace them with accessible controls bound to the native add-to-cart quantity while preserving the default value.

HOME-INT-04 high knowledge accordion: initial state is [true,false], but opening the second row yields [true,true] rather than the single-expanded source pattern, and both SVG URLs stay unchanged through open/close transitions. Enforce the intended accordion state and swap the exact open/closed icon attachments with state.
Runtime probe passed: no pageerror events occurred during the isolated interactions. Shared header/menu behavior was not re-audited in this route unit.
